node.statement: The exhaustive registered-definition list consists of column-hilbert-inner-product-displays, compressed-product-display, def-ha-map, def-hcb-datum, epsilon-banach-cstar-norm-axioms, nonvanishing-delta-projection, one-dimensional-projection-nonvanishing, operator-algebra-theta-framing, operator-space-matrix-norm-axioms, and theta-idempotent-approximation-map. None defines the adjective extended for an epsilon-C*-algebra. In particular, epsilon-banach-cstar-norm-axioms has the conditional form that an epsilon-C*-algebra obeys its lower C*-axiom; it does not assert that amplifications of an extended algebra satisfy that premise. Ruan axioms likewise control norms under scalar compression and direct sums but do not relate the amplified compressed multiplication to the C*-axiom. Hence there is no permitted modus-ponens chain from the external conclusion to the claimed all-n square inequality.
